subject: MAP weekly: performance benchmarking review & tuning next steps
body:
From: Lara Benson <lara@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: performance review and next milestones

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Acme asked me to kick off the MAP checkpoint for performance. We ran the sample traffic over the weekend and collected latency/throughput traces. High-level ask: can Redwood confirm whether the Dedicated config we discussed (4x A100 equivalent) will meet the 95th percentile latency target of 220ms for our 1k token sequences?

Attached: sample_traces.zip (excerpt).

We'll plan to decide on the commit window by end of next week. Can your engineering team review and propose tuning steps?

Regards,
Lara Benson
Director of Data Products | Acme Analytics

---

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Lara Benson <lara@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: performance review and next milestones

Hi Lara — thanks for the traces and the prompt. I ran a quick pass with Marissa and Maya and captured an initial read below. We'll follow up with a short call tomorrow (30 min) to walk through the results and confirm the tuning plan.

Quick summary from our side (initial):
- 95p observed on your traces: ~300ms on 4x baseline (no KV cache, no batching).
- Bottleneck: attention kernel scheduling during long prefixes + burst tail latencies (spiky GC-like pauses in your collector).
- Good news: we can get to ~210–230ms with targeted changes: KV caching of warm prefixes, modest batching (batch size 4), and a model variant quant profile.

Proposed next steps before our call:
1) Marissa to run controlled microbench with your exact sequence lengths and produce a bench PDF.
2) Maya to draft MAP milestone update and close timeline for commit decision.
3) Nikhil to coordinate SOW/commit options once we confirm numbers.

I'm attaching the MAP milestone spreadsheet and a draft agenda for tomorrow.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-07-19_MAP_milestones.xlsx

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Lara Benson <lara@acmeanalytics.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: performance review and next milestones — bench run results

Hi all — I ran the controlled microbench against Acme's sample set this morning and attached the short report (benchmark_report_v2.pdf). Highlights:

- Test config: 4x A100-equivalent nodes, seq len median 700 / 95p 1000, model variant: open-llama-70B quant-aware.
- Raw results: 95p = 298ms (baseline), tail spikes to 420ms under burst traffic.
- With KV cache warm (prefix reuse ~60%), 95p reduces to ~215ms; end-to-end throughput improves ~18% with batching (x4).
- Suggested tuning: enable KV cache, apply small-batch continuous batching (size 3–4), and enable the medium quant profile.

Actionable items included in the PDF: command lines, perf flags, and a short runbook for QA.

Marissa Cole
Senior Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: benchmark_report_v2.pdf

From: Lara Benson <lara@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: performance review and next milestones — bench run results

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. Two clarifications before the call:
1) Do you have an estimate of the engineer-days to implement KV caching + batching in our Dedicated environment?
2) If the medium quant profile is used, can you share the expected delta in model quality on our internal eval set (roughly acceptable threshold: <1.5% mean metric drop)?

Prefer to close on the commit by Friday if numbers look good.

Best,
Lara

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Lara Benson <lara@acmeanalytics.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: performance review and next milestones — action owners and timeline

Thanks Lara — answering inline:

1) Eng-days estimate: 3–4 engineer-days for runbooked KB cache + batching integration in Dedicated (Marissa + 1 infra engineer). We'll include validation runs and a short QA pass.
2) Quality delta: Marissa ran a quick eval sweep; medium quant profile shows ~1.1% mean metric drop on your eval subset (below your 1.5% threshold). We'll produce a more complete eval by Thursday EOD.

Proposed MAP checkpoint / decision timeline (short):
- Wed (tomorrow): 30-min review call (share call notes).
- Thu EOD: full eval and final perf numbers shipped by Marissa.
- Fri noon: Acme decision on commit / reserved capacity.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa Cole: deliver full perf report + quant eval (due 2026-07-23T17:00:00-07:00).
- Infra: Justin (cc'd on internal thread only) to validate Dedicated config and provide a deploy checklist (ETA 2 business days).
- Nikhil Sharma: prepare pricing/commit options and SOW templates (due Fri noon).
- Maya Srinivasan: update MAP document and post decision summary to the shared Drive link.

I'll send a short meeting invite for the call.

Maya Srinivasan
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
